params.name: directory
params.description: Directory access path to display by default, or empty string for the default user folder, or a number (1-32000) of a memorized access path.

params.name: selected
params.description: Array filled with the access paths and names of all selected files, in case of multiple selection.

overloads.semanticRole: The Select document command displays a standard open document dialog box which allows the user to set one or more files and returns the name and/or full access path of the selected file(s).

constraints: The mechanical draft left 'selected' with direction 'in', but the doc's arrow column marks it '<-' (out): the command writes the list of selected files into it.

directory as a memorized-path number (1-32000) lets 4D remember, per number, the last folder the user browsed to and reuse it as the default on subsequent calls; under Windows this is kept for the session only, under macOS it persists across sessions.
